record_title: Near-maximum connected mutual visibility and Nordhaus--Gaddum equality
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: The Nordhaus--Gaddum equality classification is stated for n>=5; order 4 has additional small-order equality cases. The parameter was introduced in arXiv:2609.18877v1, so very recent or not-yet-indexed parallel work remains a residual originality risk. No independent validation is asserted.
